build_poolformer_backbone: build a PoolFormer backbone model with architecture s12 for image classification feature extraction
create_poolformer_block: create a PoolFormerBlock with pooling-based token mixer and MLP for a single transformer stage
build_patch_embedding: build a PatchEmbed module to project input images into patch embeddings via convolution
create_pooling_module: create a Pooling module that applies average pooling minus identity for token mixing
freeze_poolformer_stages: freeze early stages of a PoolFormer backbone to prevent gradient updates during fine-tuning
